text: Sea's Digital Entertainment (Garena) revenue rose 26.1%, from US$1.9 billion in FY2024 to US$2.4 billion in FY2025. According to Sea's management discussion, this increase was primarily driven by growth in the active user base and deeper paying-user penetration: average quarterly active users (Game QAUs) grew 5.7% (from 622.3 million to 657.7 million), while average quarterly paying users (Game QPUs) grew more sharply by 23.9% (from 50.5 million to 62.6 million) [Sea, FY2025, p.100].

answer: Sea's Digital Entertainment (Garena) revenue rose 26.1%, from US$1.9 billion in FY2024 to US$2.4 billion in FY2025. According to Sea's management discussion, this increase was primarily driven by growth in the active user base and deeper paying-user penetration: average quarterly active users (Game QAUs) grew 5.7% (from 622.3 million to 657.7 million), while average quarterly paying users (Game QPUs) grew more sharply by 23.9% (from 50.5 million to 62.6 million) [Sea, FY2025, p.100].
